tx.sub_studios: Films in your library, by studio

request.search_hint: Search movies and shows to request
up.subtitle: What's on the way to your library

up.foot_missing: Released, but not in your library yet.

up.episodes_range.note: Phase R179: multi-episode file (e.g. S01E01E02E03.mkv) combined card copy.

fd.audio.note: R240 (Phase 202) — the focus-detail status line (L) / row-open panel (J). Facts only; every number is server-resolved (FocusDetailFacts), these four strings are the only presentation.

slow_lead.note: R222 (Phase 185) — the "slow to start" note. Three rejected candidates recorded in the spec so they aren't re-proposed: "may not play smoothly" (predicts a stutter R216/177 already prevent), "can't handle this file at full quality" (implies a quality control exists), "better on the Living room TV" (household logistics, out of scope).

slow_tail_measured: The last few times it took about {n} seconds.
slow_tail_expected: Give it a moment after you press play.

profile.mylist_empty.text: Nothing here yet. Tap ＋ My List on any title and it waits for you here — and on your TV.
profile.mylist_empty.note: R304 — the phone's Profile page: identity, My List, Account (app language on the per-viewer setting, change password, settings), Sign out with its one sheet, and the version line. Never names Jellyfin (FR-R304-6).

profile.app_language_note: Menus and buttons only. Audio and subtitles keep following your profile's languages.
profile.signout_body: Your TVs and other devices stay signed in. To watch here again you sign in with your name and password.
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your username and password to sign in on this device.
login.error_invalid: Wrong username or password — check them and try again
login.error_unreachable: Couldn't reach the server — try again

browse.facet.genre.note: R187 — the generic browse page's facet bar / popovers / sort.

browse.sort.title: Title
settings.unpair_desc: Removes every signed-in profile from this TV and returns to setup.
settings.sign_out_desc: You'll need your username and password to sign back in as {name} on this TV. Other signed-in profiles on this TV aren't affected.
player.variant_plain: The full version of everything spoken.
player.variant_sdh: Adds speaker names and sound-effect notes.
player.variant_forced: Only the on-screen text and foreign lines.
player.variant_commentary: A recorded commentary on this title.
player.variant_no_distinguishing_data: This one carries no name of its own — pick it to see it.

player.picker_preview_hint.note: R197 — reworded: R195 originally described a "moving down the list previews each one" flow that was never actually built (OK/tap always applied-and-stayed-open, never previewed on focus move); now OK/tap applies and closes, same as every other row.

pl.subtitles.note: R244 — the player on a phone (FR-R244-16). No speed strings, by owner decision.

cast.ready.text: Ready to play from your phone
cast.ready.note: R245 — casting (FR-R245-12). {device} is the Chromecast's own name as the viewer named it.

cast.converted_body: {device} can’t play this file as it is, so your server is converting it while it plays. The picture is a step below the original. For the best quality, play it in the Ravilo app on the TV.
cast.lost_sub: It may still be playing. Ravilo cannot reach it to check.

cast.failed.note: R299 — the receiver loaded the title and could not play it (a codec it lacks, most often). It is idle and reachable; this is not a lost connection. {device} is the TV's own name.

cast.failed_sub: Try another title, or play it on this phone.

cast.play_here.note: R299 — opens the same title in the phone's own player.

cast.no_server_sub: Check that the server is on and try again from your phone.
srv.busy: The server is busy right now
srv.busy_sub: It will start as soon as it can.

screens.title.note: R265 — one glyph, three tiers (Play on a TV). No product, protocol or status code in any of these.

screens.code_hint: The code is on the TV’s screen.

screens.airplay_footnote.note: R270 (FR-R270-6, dev review item 5) — RENAMED. This key has always held the footnote's own words; leaving it called `_notice` is how a connecting bar ends up displaying a parenthetical.

screens.airplay_notice.text: Your phone has to stay on and in Ravilo — the TV stops when you close the app.
screens.airplay_notice.note: The full caveat the footnote compresses. Shown once, at the moment it becomes true (the connecting bar), and in the admin's Settings → Connections help text. New: it did not exist in any language.

screens.in_use.note: FR-R270-3/-5 — the fallback when the viewer cannot be named. Never "Busy · is watching" with a hole where the name should be.

wd.mon.note: R270 (FR-R270-4) — full weekday names for "Offline · last seen {when}". Localised rather than hard-coded: this is user-facing copy inside a sentence, in a trilingual household.

error.load.reauth.title.note: R280 (FR-R280-5) — a screen failed to load because this device's session no longer works (401 or 409). Deliberately not the player's wording: that one says "to keep watching", which is wrong on Settings. Names what the viewer must do, never the component that failed.

error.load.reauth.body: This device's session has ended. Sign in again to carry on.
error.load.forbidden.title: Not available on this profile
error.load.gone.title: This isn't here any more

error.play.reauth.title.text: This TV needs to be signed in again
error.play.reauth.title.note: R237 (FR-R237-2) — a start that failed for a reason we know, said in words the viewer can act on. Per the constitution's copy rule (and R234's rejected "Your Jellyfin password"), these name what the viewer must do, never the component that failed: no product name, no protocol, no status code.

error.play.reauth.body: Sign in again on this TV to keep watching.
error.play.forbidden.title: Not available on this profile
error.play.forbidden.body: This title isn't part of what this profile can watch.
error.play.gone.title: This title isn't available any more
error.play.unreachable.title: Couldn't reach the server
error.play.unreachable.body: Check the connection and try again.

loading.still_trying.note: R237 (FR-R237-5) — one line added to R218's existing cold-start treatment once a first attempt has already failed. No progress count, no attempt number, no new visual language.

home.showing_saved.text: Showing saved content — trying to reconnect
home.showing_saved.note: R212 — shown on Home when a cached snapshot is displayed and the background refresh keeps failing.

receiver.starts_in.note: R245 — the Chromecast/Tizen next-up countdown. {n} is whole seconds.

receiver.setup_title.note: R269 — the receiver's one screen that is not playback: asking for a server address. Tizen only; a Chromecast is served by the backend, so its origin IS the server.

receiver.setup_hint.note: R269 — shown under the input; the scheme is inferred, so never mention http/https.

receiver.setup_connect.note: R269 — the button on the server-setup screen.

receiver.setup_trying.note: R269 — while the address is being probed.

receiver.setup_not_found.text: There’s no Ravilo server at that address
receiver.setup_not_found.note: R269 — the probe failed. Deliberately does not name a status code or a protocol.

receiver.failed.note: R264 — the receiver-only TV app, a title that did not play for a reason R237 has no sentence of its own for (the player itself failed, an unexpected answer). No status code, no product, no protocol.

receiver.failed_sub.note: R264 — under receiver.failed (and under a title that is gone): the TV has no menu, so the phone is where to try again.
